items.statement_scope: Whole C4, counted once: fixed c>1, Gn~G(n,c/n), uniformly chosen x,y,z in its giant, uniformly sampled shortest paths. For every epsilon>0, with graph probability >1-epsilon the conditional triangle probability of slimness>delta_n exceeds 1-epsilon, delta_n=floor((0.5 log n-9 log log n)/log c)-M(epsilon,c), eventually. Author Theorem1 states this scale with a stronger pointwise-in-fixed-geodesics convention.
